mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.5% signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with UNRATE > 4.5, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with both HOUST and RSAFS declining, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 320) trigger expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as bond yields rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 320, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index) signals manufacturing contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate output and earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with PAYEMS > 158000, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST above 1240) reflect strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with HOUST > 1240, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.
